attachments.content:
Northstar Care Staffing
Rate card – from 1st of this month

Registered nurse: on request
Care assistant: on request

One hourly rate for every shift, nights and weekends included.
Minimum booking 6 hours. Cancellation free of charge up to 24 hours before the shift; later cancellations are charged in full.
Lead time: as stated in the booking portal for each offer.

mails.body:
Hello,

Attached is our updated rate card. Nothing changes for bookings already confirmed. As always, please book through the portal so the shift details are complete.

Best wishes
Sophie Mensah
Northstar Care Staffing
mails.subject: Updated rate card

mails.body:
Dear all,

Thank you for the last month's figures. Across the region overtime went up again. From now on I'll ask each home for a short reason when a planning period ends above the contracted hours. No action needed today.

Best regards
Ben Murphy
mails.subject: Hours report for the region

mails.body:
Hello,

Mohammed King

mails.body:

mails.body:
Hello,

We would like to visit Mrs Okafor on Sunday afternoon with the grandchildren. Is there anything we should know about visiting times at the moment? And could someone let us know how she has been sleeping?

Many thanks
Rhys James
mails.subject: Visiting on Sunday

mails.body:
Hi all,

The next staff forum is on Thu 17 Sep 2026 at 2pm in the training room. On the agenda: rotas for the coming weeks, overtime and training. Please send me any points beforehand.

Thanks
Emily Wood
mails.subject: Staff forum – date for your diary

mails.body:
Hi Ella,

The rota from Sun 13 Sep is published. Open points are in the rota as usual.

Mohammed King
Rota coordinator, Laurel House
mails.subject: Rota published

mails.body:
Hi all,

The fire alarm will be checked on Fri 18 Sep 2026 between 10:00 and 10:30. Please reassure residents beforehand. No evacuation.

Ella
mails.subject: Fire alarm check on Fri 18 Sep

mails.body:
Dear Mohammed,

Please find attached the hours we processed for August 2026. For the next run we need any changes to contracted hours, new starters and leavers by Sun 20 Sep 2026. Hours above or below contract go to each person's hours account and are balanced with time off; overtime is paid out only when the home manager approves it.

If any of the figures look wrong, reply to this mail with the staff number and the corrected hours – please do not edit the file.

Kind regards
Ella Clarke
Hartwell Payroll Bureau
mails.subject: Payroll cut-off for August and next run

mails.body:
Hello,

Thank you
Tomasz Brown

mails.body:
Hi Mohammed,

A few things for the coming days:
- overtime only where it is really needed – the regional office is watching hours closely
- please make sure everyone who is moved gets a shift message

I'm in meetings most of tomorrow morning; message me in the chat if something can't wait.

Ella
